paite: Kumpipa lungtang TOUPA khut a om ahi, tui lampite bang in; a-utna lamlam ah ahei hi.
english: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

paite: Mihing lampi chiteng amah mit ah adik a; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte abuk hi.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.

paite: Diktatna leh vaihawmna hih kithoihna sang in TOUPA a ding in alaktakzaw hi.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

paite: Mit hah sang leh lungtang kisathei, migilou khawnvak nangawn, khelhna ahi.
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

paite: Mipil ngaihtuahnate'n hauhsakna lam kia anawt a; himahleh michih kinohhat taksapna lam kia ah akinoh hi.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

paite: Lei zuauthei agou muh tuimei lehlam lehlam a mutleng bang ahi; huaite zong mite'n sihna azong uhi.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

paite: Migilou hiamgamna in amaute ataimang ding; vaihawmna hih anial ziak un.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

paite: Amah mohna a dimpa lampi akawi mahmah a; himahleh misiangthou ahihleh, athilhih adik ahi.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

paite: Inn zapi sung a numei selhat toh ten sang in, intung vum ning a ten ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

paite: Migilou kha in hoih lou adeih; a-invengte in amit ah deihsakna atang kei hi.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

paite: Muhsit hatmi gawt a a-om chiang in, mimawl bawlpil in a-om hi; huan mipil hilh a a-om chiang in, theihna amu hi.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

paite: Midiktat in migilou inkuan angaihtuah; migiloute amau siatna ding in vuallel a a-omdan uh.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei kahna a bil hum, amah leng akap ding, himahleh zak in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

paite: Aguk a thilpiak in hehna anemzou, huan angsung a van tawi in hehna mahmah.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

paite: Midiktat a ding in vaihawmna hih kipahna ahi, himahleh thulim lou hihte a ding in siatna ahi.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

paite: Theihsiamna lampi a kipan vakmangmi misite kikhopna ah akhawl ding.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

paite: Kuapeuh nopbawlna it migenthei ahi ding; kuapeuh uain leh sathau hai ahau kei ding uh.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

paite: Migilou midiktat a ding in tatna sum ahi a, huan mitang mun ah milepchiah ahong pai hi.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

paite: Numei kisel hat leh kinak hat kiang sang in gamkeu a ten ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

paite: Mipil tenna ah gou leh sathau manpha a-om; himahleh mihai in huai anawmvalh vek hi.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

paite: Kuapeuh diktatna leh zahngaihna delh in hinna, diktatna leh zahtakhuaina amu ding hi.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

paite: Mipil mihatte khopi ah akah a, huai lai a muanna hatna aphel hi.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

paite: Kuapeuh kamsim a, pau lou in buainate a kipan akha akemhoih hi.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

paite: Mikisathei leh uang, amin muhsit hat ahi, kisaktheihna leh ki-otsakna in thil ahih zel hi.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

paite: Thadahmi deih in amah athat a; akhutte'n sepgim anial ngal uh.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

paite: Nitum a duhgawltak a huaiham a-om a; himahleh midiktat in apia a, a-it kei hi.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

paite: Migilou kithoihna kihhuai ahi, lungsim gilou toh huai ahon tawi chiang in, bangchi phet a kihhuai sem ahi diam aw!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

paite: Theihpih zuauthei amangthang ding; himahleh azami in kalh vual louh in thu agen ding.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

paite: Migilou in amaitang a taksak a himahleh mitang ahihleh bel, alampite abawlhoih hi.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

paite: TOUPA kalh in pilna hiam theihsiamna hiam thupha hiam a-om kei hi.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

paite: Kidou ni a ding in sakol bawlsa ahi; himahleh vualzohna TOUPA a ahi.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
